arms.native: Ordinary native run; capture x10 and x18.
arms.writer: Ordinary compact-writer run; capture x10 and x18.
arms.R1M0_dynamic: Writer x10 with all A10--M17 outputs clamped native.
arms.R0M1_dynamic: Native x10 with all A10--M17 outputs clamped writer.

arms.direct_add: Install native x18 + g10*(writer x10-native x10) at the final residual boundary.
arms.direct_remove: Install writer x18 - g10*(writer x10-native x10) at the final residual boundary.

predictions.pred_e_identity_carriage_is_selectively_: On original HOLDOUT and both OOD phases, direct removal eliminates at least half of the compact writer effect in the registered direction while every nonnative arm stays below the temporal-command collateral bar.

nulls.invalid: If A fails, no scientific prediction is interpreted.
nulls.arithmetic_or_hook_failure: If B or C fails, the direct physical route is not established; repair only a proven instrument defect without changing scientific bars.
nulls.ood_instability: If B/C pass but D fails, the exact identity exists on the measured boundary but is not a stable OOD circuit route.
nulls.nonselective_or_redundant: If B--D pass but E fails, identity carriage is sufficient but not independently necessary/selective under this intervention family; preserve redundancy or nonlinear readout interaction rather than claiming removal.
